title: STG Studio

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: In 2021 we opened our new studio space for season production rehearsals and STG Studio classes, camps, and workshops. This space is used on a weekly basis for educational programming, rehearsals, and more to come! STG Studio venue is available to rent for meetings, rehearsals, and other small events. For more information click here. STG uses Unity Village on occasion throughout its season for smaller production performances and special educational programming needs. Unity offers a beautiful landscape backdrop - we encourage our patrons to visit their nature trails! The Lee’s Summit West High School Performing Arts Center hosts our large summer musical as well as our Kids Musical Performance
